rows.36:11b8:
And when she eats her lunch, she always prays for over ten minutes before she starts.
I can't tell what she's saying, but she mutters away in a tiny voice, mumble mumble mumble.
Then she bows to her lunch box over and over and over.
And only then does she finally start eating.
Unbelievable, right?
And when she eats, she's got to be chewing every bite more than thirty times.
I mean, she eats incredibly slowly.
She uses up the whole lunch break eating.
Then, when she's done, she bows to her lunch box again and starts praying, mumble mumble mumble.
She's unhinged, huh?
Kind of scary, right?
But you know, it's not like she's dumb.
She's actually pretty good at studying.
She always ranks near the top on tests and stuff.
And she doesn't get bullied, either.
It kind of bugs me to say it as a girl myself, but she's really cute.
You know, the kind of face everybody likes?
Girls like that have it easy, huh?
Even I find Sanae really irritating sometimes, but then I go, 'Oh, whatever,' and forgive her right away.
Actually, we're pretty good friends.
Maybe I'm weird too.
Besides, Sanae may be weird, but she's fun.{p}
rows.36:1b68:
I figured she hadn't heard me, so I asked again, a little louder.
"Hey, Sanae, are you okay?"
Still no answer.
I didn't know what to do anymore, so I shook her hard by the shoulder.
"Sanae! Sanae!"
I was screaming.
Then a mop of messy hair came poking out of the blanket.
The face was hideously swollen, and the lips had gone purple and hung open, curled back.
It was a face you couldn't bear to look at twice.
rows.36:32f0:
I had a bad feeling about this, and I thought about running away.
But our eyes had met, right?
No point running away then.
Besides, she's my friend.
"Sanae!"
Without thinking, I grabbed her hand.
It was shockingly cold.
Just like a dead person's.
I almost let go without meaning to.
But then Sanae squeezed my hand tight.
I was about ready to cry.
"Reiko, stay like this.
Keep holding my hand, okay?"
She said it with blank, unfocused eyes.
She was looking at me, but her eyes seemed to go right through me, looking at something behind me.{p}
rows.36:3700:
I felt like she'd see through me if I lied...
So I answered honestly.
"What... was that?
Sanae, did you know about it yourself?"{p}
rows.36:404c:
And then, guess what? Right around her slightly open mouth, I could see human faces.
Tiny human faces, like the heads of matchsticks.
There must have been about twenty of them.
And they were all staring hard at the lunch.
Those faces were each saying whatever they liked.
I froze up again.
Just then, Sanae suddenly grabbed my hand.{p}
rows.36:4610:
sat up all of a sudden and walked right out of the nurse's office.
With her face still pale.
I wondered where she could be going when she felt so sick, but...
I wanted to know what Sanae had been doing in the bed, so I took a quick look at the bed.
And from inside the pillowcase...{p}
rows.36:471c:
...Want to know?
What'll you give me if I tell you?
Ahaha, kidding, kidding.
So, from inside the pillowcase, out came a little scrap of paper.
Sanae must have been fiddling around under there to slip it in.{p}
rows.36:48d0:
It's 'ketsu' as in 'decide,' right?
Hiding the word 'decide' in a bed...
You'd think she was brooding over something, wouldn't you?
So I got worried and went looking for Sanae.{p}
rows.36:4aa8:
Clink, clunk... like that.
There wasn't any class in the chemistry lab at that hour.
Right away, I thought,
it might be Sanae.
Maybe Sanae was troubled about something and was going through the chemical cabinet to take some deadly chemical from the lab.
So I quietly peeked in.{p}
rows.36:5070:
But she wasn't in the classroom, and it didn't look like she'd gone back to P.E. either.
I was wandering up and down the hallway, wondering what to do.
Then I heard a sound coming from the chemistry lab.
rows.36:5308:
I'm pretty sure there's an idol by that name... And fans carve letters into their desks and stuff, right?
'Ketsu Forever.'
Like that.
People always say that if you sleep with a photo of someone you like, or a paper with their name on it, under your pillow, you'll dream about them.
It's a good thing I was the one who found it...
If a teacher found out she was skipping class to do that, she'd be in big trouble.
Whew, that was scary.
My heart was really pounding.
But you know...
I thought, so even Sanae falls for idols.
She's a girl after all...
Come to think of it, the kids in class had been gossiping about a concert yesterday...
Our school bans gigs and concerts, so everybody has no choice but to go in secret.
Maybe Sanae was one of them?{p}
rows.36:6c7c:
The chemistry teacher would have been better, really, but it was during class.
They were off teaching in some classroom, so I went to tell the school nurse instead.{p}
rows.36:83ac:
Thought so, you don't get it.
Sanae stopped being human!
That doesn't mean she died, though.
...Hmm, I guess you'd call her a monster.
She turned into a rokurokubi!
I didn't know either, but apparently rokurokubi are monsters born from ectoplasm...
It's true.
The ectoplasm I thought had vanished back then didn't vanish. It merged with Sanae.
So now Sanae's a rokurokubi, and while her body sleeps, she stretches her neck way, way out and goes all kinds of places, apparently.
She even came over to visit me.
Though only people with a sixth sense can see her, I hear...
You seem to have a sixth sense, {c}{f:|}, so you might be able to see the rokurokubi...
Try sleeping with your window curtains open tonight.
...That's the end of my story.
Whose turn is next?{p}
rows.36:86c8:
I have to run!
That's the first thing I thought...
And I ran away.
Sanae didn't come after me.
But that ectoplasm came after me...
It overtook me and went off somewhere.
I'd been gone from P.E. so long that the bell rang for the end of class.
I went straight back to the classroom, and...{p}
rows.36:890c:
Ever since then, the ectoplasm has never come back out of my eyes.
So sometimes my eyes hurt really badly.
Well, it only hurts, that's all.
Even now, a little...
Oh, sorry.
...Have you heard?
They say there are two types of spirits.
One is the 'let them go' type.
If someone sees it and runs away, it just leaves them alone.
The other type chases you harder the more you run.
Sanae's ectoplasm was the type of spirit that chases you...
If you ever meet a spirit like that, you mustn't run.
Got it?
Don't run.
Right now, the ectoplasm from the story I just told is inside my body...
Even if it comes out of my eyes, whatever you do, don't run, okay?
If you run... don't blame me.
Though it would suit me better if you did run.
...That's the end of my story.
Whose turn is next?{p}
rows.36:a7f4:
She was wearing a black cloak and holding a thick book in her hands.
When I looked closer, there was a magic circle drawn in chalk at her feet!
For a second, I hesitated to call out to her.
But Sanae noticed me right away,
"Reiko, what are you doing?
Come over here!"
she called to me, just like that.
She was the same old Sanae.
Her color was completely back to normal, too...
"Watch this. I'm going to summon something amazing."
With that, Sanae turned back to the magic circle and started chanting some weird spell.
"In the name of heaven, earth and the spirits, I, one who received life between heaven and earth, do command thee.
Keeper of the door, swiftly open thy gate and forge the path that leads that one to this land.
The one whose name is Ketsu La Mondo, come forth! Before me!"
It was all so much like a manga.
It really was like something out of a manga or a TV show.{p}
rows.36:c1b4:
What's wrong?
If you just stay quiet, I can't tell what you think.
Either answer is fine.
Whether you believe it or not is up to you, {c}{f:|}.
Well, if you're unsure, it'd be better to save the rest of this story for another time.
Next time, once you're able to believe it.
Okay then, that's as far as my story goes.
On to the next person.{p}
